meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后，当你请 Claude 修复 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的缺陷时，它会先复现 bug、写失败测试、实施最小修复并验证通过；随后按归属提交：LazyCodex 系以 issue 附补丁提交，上游 Codex 则从 fork 创建 PR。
howto.when: 当你说出“修复 bug”“为 bug 开 PR”等要求，或提出调试并提交 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: LazyCodex 的安装脚本在 Windows 上报错，请修复并提交。
帮我调试并提交 omo-codex 的一个缺陷修复。
say.note: 经调试后按归属自动选择 issue 或 PR 交付。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you ask Claude to fix a LazyCodex or Codex defect, it reproduces the bug, writes a failing test, implements the smallest fix, and verifies it. Then it delivers per ownership: LazyCodex-owned issues get an issue with an embedded patch, while upstream Codex gets a PR from a fork.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: The LazyCodex installer fails on Windows; fix it and contribute the fix.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces, fixes, and files an issue with a patch on lazycodex.

say_en.text: There's a bug in openai/codex's --model parsing; open a PR to fix it.
say_en.note: Claude creates a PR from a fork with before/after logs.

say_en.text: Help me debug and submit a fix for an omo-codex defect.
say_en.note: After debugging, it delivers via issue or PR depending on ownership.
